opening.argument: Forsage is presented as a route to success, with the speaker asserting, "This system gives you money when you are sleeping." The account screen reinforces a participation-and-recruitment structure through a personal invite link and counters showing 36 partners and a team of 541, while the notifications identify program levels and record that a new partner joined. Together, these features support a tiered recruitment-and-commissions presentation rather than neutral discussion, especially alongside the claim of passive earnings. The evidence does not establish payment amounts, platform terms, withdrawal success, or completed transactions, and therefore does not support broader claims about actual losses or outcomes.
